hours_note: All hours are estimates from PowerPyx (about 200 hours to platinum, difficulty 4/10) and Push Square (up to 300 hours or more). Your own time will vary.
point_of_no_return: There is no mission replay and only 15 manual save slots plus 1 autosave. Keep a manual save at the start and end of every chapter. The only trophy with a known point of no return is Positive Mental Attitude: Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house is only available in Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth. Do it before Chapter 1 ends and keep that save until the trophy pops. Cheats disable trophies and saving, so keep cheats off for the whole run.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

stages.goal: Finish Chapters 1 and 2, do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation, and start scanning vehicles and animals as you travel.
stages.tips: Use the 15 manual save slots: one at the start and one at the end of each chapter. Scan every new vehicle with WAiNK and study new animals with binoculars as you meet them; both counts feed the 100% checklist later.
stages.title: Chapters 1–2 — Leonida opens, and the one missable moment
stages.warning: POINT OF NO RETURN: after the Chapter 1 mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony at Jason's house and accept her meditation. It is gone once Chapter 1 ends. Keep a manual save from Chapter 1 until Positive Mental Attitude pops.

stages.goal: Finish Chapters 3 and 4 and the final mission, unlocking free roam and the 100% completion checklist.
stages.tips: Learn the robbery systems as they unlock: the Key Cloner in Chapter 3, jewelry jobs, and the bank-vault introduction in Chapter 4. Do optional missions as they appear, since each one counts toward the 100 optional missions the checklist wants.
stages.title: Chapters 3–5 — the story chain to the credits
stages.warning: Make a manual save before the final mission. There is no mission replay, and the post-story cleanup is long, so a save at the end of the story is your way back.

stages.goal: Finish the six side-character questlines and 8 stranger strands, all of which stay open after the story.
stages.tips: Andy is Lucia-only and Tyrone and Bret are Jason-only, so switch characters to pick up their calls. Only some stranger strands count toward Strangers & Freaks; the confirmed ones are Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete, so check the trophy tracker as you finish each strand.
stages.title: Stranger strands — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret
stages.warning: None of these chains is missable: quest givers who go quiet mid-story, such as Kenton, come back later. Do not restart over a temporarily unavailable giver.

stages.goal: Clear the big count trophies: 250 stunts, 42 shooting-range golds, 3 card sets, 100 WAiNK scans, 100 vehicles, and a fully unfogged map.
stages.tips: Under-bridge flights are the fastest stunts. The shooting ranges are Rodgers Ranch in Port Gellhorn and Griffin in Balsero. Card sets feed the checklist too, which wants 15 of 18 sets, so keep collecting past 3 sets.
stages.title: Collectibles and counts — stunts, cards, WAiNK, exploration
stages.warning: No count in this stage is missable. Everything can be finished in post-story free roam, so do not grind it all mid-story.

stages.goal: Try all 9 activity types, win 20 different races and a drone race at all 14 locations, beat Cal's fishing challenge, finish an arcade game, and pull off the two partner wanted-level feats.
stages.tips: Drone races and the 20 race wins are separate counts, so a drone win does not count toward the 20 races. For Hot Together, the train tunnel north of Ambrosia is the easiest escape. For Retail Therapy, the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City work well, and the pop is delayed about 30 seconds.
stages.title: Activities, races and partner feats
stages.warning: Hot Together and Retail Therapy both need your partner beside you, which is only possible after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. Call your partner with Right plus Triangle before you start either one.

stages.goal: Rob 5 bank vaults and an armored truck, rob one illegal operation per gang, steal a tank and a docked plane, rob a jewelry store unseen, and bank $250,000 in laundered bills, $100,000 spent, 8 garages and 10 registered vehicles.
stages.tips: Vaults pay up to $205,000 each, so the money trophies fill while you do the 8 large bank jobs the checklist needs. Buy garages through the Vice City Real Estate app before you register vehicles, since each garage adds a parking spot.
stages.title: Crime, money and property
stages.warning: Bank vaults trigger a 4-star wanted level every time, so plan a motorcycle escape and a vehicle swap. The Irredeemable criminal profile is permanent, so avoid excessive violence if you want police to stay calmer.

stages.goal: Finish the last 50 challenges, the cocktail, showroom, bowling and strength feats, the 500 criminal-profile actions, the UFO easter egg, and the two unconfirmed trophies, then complete the 100% checklist for A Long Road and the platinum.
stages.tips: One Last Thing needs 50 challenges and the checklist needs 70 of 80, so pick the easiest remaining challenges last. Actions Speak Louder fills passively to 500 across the whole run. When A Long Road pops, Vice Got a Price! follows at once if it is the last trophy left.
stages.title: Secrets, choices and the platinum
stages.warning: Bad Luck, I Guess and Ten Pin have no confirmed method in any launch-era guide. Do not follow an uncited method for them; check updated guides and keep playing normally. A Long Road is the last gate before the platinum.
